[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]

The [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/JojaMart]Joja Mart[/url] interior map now has its own unique[size=1] *[/size] music.
This audio was not ripped from any game or soundtrack.

It no longer replaces music from locations that use the same ambient sound.
For example, the Introduction, Spa and Sebastian's Two-Heart Event.

Recommended mod manager is [url=https://github.com/Modorganizer2/modorganizer/releases]Mod Organizer 2[/url].

[size=1]* This is a mini-arrangement of [url=https://youtu.be/s2_MAplvHeQ]Floral Life[/url] by CODASOUND.
I transcribed this in, like, probably 9 minutes. It sounds bad on purpose.[/size]


[center][soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/ungloved3397/jojamart[/soundcloud]
[size=1]Character Art is by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url][/b].
The music sounds better in-game tbh.[/size][/center]

[b][size=4]CUSTOMIZATION[/size][/b]

If you really like the [url=https://youtu.be/NKFNBswv718]Toon Town Elevator[/url] song, you can still use it.
Download the file [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10115]here[/url] and rename [u]filter.wav[/u] to [u]jojamart.wav[/u].

[b][size=4]RECOGNITION[/size][/b]

IDK. Shoutouts to General MIDI Instruments.
